name: BI Unfuck Systems
desc: Core engine-level fixes and overrides for BI AI behaviour, configs, and scheduling. Everything else depends on this.
video: video/Arma Reforger DCO AI - Failing hard against our AI.mp4

name: Cover Booking System
desc: Global cover manager that reserves a cover position per soldier, so two AI never run to the same spot. Bookings auto-release after a timeout.

name: Threat & Suppression Model
desc: Each soldier accumulates threat from near misses, fly-bys and explosions, with natural falloff over time. Feeds morale, cover decisions and return fire. Latest scaling fix is in the dev build.

name: Aim correction
desc: AI will zero in on their targets over time, improving accuracy the longer they fire at a target. The zeroing process will reset if the LOS is lost for a certain time or the AI switches targets.

name: Vision Limiting
desc: AI will have a slower detection time at night and will aim less accurate in night time.

name: Individual morale
desc: The individual AI's emotional reaction to pressure such as passing bullets, near misses, explosions, wounds etc. Low morale will increase the chance for a soldier to take cover, go prone or hide from enemy fire and do so for a longer time. Soldiers with high morale will be more aggressive, will push forward and will return fire with less chance of heading for cover. At the extremes, a BREAK state forces a full prone reflex and a MANIAC state makes the soldier refuse to go prone.

name: AI Personality
desc: Every soldier is Cautious, Standard, Aggressive or Reckless. Personality scales how long they stay pinned before returning fire (8s down to 2s), how stubbornly they hold a firing position, how far they search for cover and how freely they spend ammo.

name: Suppression
desc: AI's ability to suppress detected or identified enemies. Suppression will lower enemy accuracy and increase their chance to seek cover.

name: Dodge
desc: Soldiers sidestep or dive away from threatening incoming fire. Triggered after a number of close shots within a time window, with cooldown and distance limits, and biased toward the group's waypoint so they don't dodge away from the objective.

name: Cover-First Engagement
desc: When engaged, AI prioritizes fighting from cover. Being in the open raises the urgency to move instead of being a hard requirement, and all danger reactions share one movement budget so soldiers don't jitter between covers.

name: Danger reaction
desc: The AI's instinctual reaction to danger events such as incoming fire, explosions, wounds etc. AI reactions will range from flinching, dodging for cover, evading, going prone in the open.

name: Break Contact & Reposition
desc: When wounded, soldiers far from the enemy break contact (sprint, unpredictable direction), while soldiers close to the enemy reposition backwards and keep their weapon on target.

name: Vocal Info sharing
desc: Contact sharing between nearby soldiers, tracked per source so the same enemy is not reported endlessly.

name: Unknown Fire Reaction
desc: When shot at by an unseen enemy, soldiers turn toward the source, hide from it and manage their stance based on threat and range instead of standing still.

name: Investigate & Push
desc: Soldiers move to investigate suspected enemy positions, choosing the flank relative to their waypoint so the push stays on the group's axis of advance.

name: Grenade Usage
desc: Soldiers throw frag grenades at enemies they can't see or hit. Safety checks enforce minimum distance and friendly clearance, and personality affects how often they throw.

name: Underbarrel Grenade Launcher
desc: Grenadiers use M203 / GP-25 launchers in short volleys with a cooldown. Works with modded weapons by detecting the launcher muzzle instead of relying on a fixed weapon slot.

name: Individual Roles
desc: Soldiers act by role: Leading, Suppressing, Anti-Armor, Covert, and Long / Medium / Close range, with reactions and engagement distances scaled to that role.

name: Individual Fire Mode Rules
desc: Per-soldier rules for fire mode selection, so riflemen, gunners and marksmen use their weapons differently.

name: Close combat behaviour
desc: IDLE Soldiers will prioritize using buildings as cover (not possible yet as it can not ID a building yet), if in melee range, soldiers will engage in melee with the enemy. If within 50 meters from detected enemies, the soldier will avoid going prone and find cover instead.

name: Ammo Conservation
desc: Suppressive fire rate now accounts for remaining ammo, so AI stops spraying at a target that is only 'maybe there'. Cautious soldiers start saving ammo earlier, reckless ones barely care.

name: Indoor Relocation
desc: Soldiers inside a building score rooms, windows and doorways against known threats and move to a better interior position instead of leaving the building.

name: Door Avoidance
desc: Indoor AI avoids standing in doorways and fatal funnels when choosing positions.

name: Breach Grenades
desc: Before entering a room suspected to hold enemies, AI throws a frag grenade in first. Respects the Grenade Usage slider.

name: Smoke Usage
desc: AI deploys smoke grenades for concealment while moving under fire.

name: IDLE behaviour
desc: A soldier that has not received a movement order in 60 seconds, will seek to spread out and take cover. If static guns are available, AI will man them automatically. Buildings and hard structures will be prioritized as cover once BI enables ID type of cover. There is a chance the soldier will patrol the nearby area, within a 150 m radius around the SL.

name: Adjust to cover
desc: AI's ability to use advanced stance adjustment to adapt to cover geometry.

name: CQB
desc: Room-by-room building clearing with a dedicated close-quarters utility: entry, sweep order and per-room assignment.

name: Squad Combat Modes
desc: Squads run Aggressive, Defensive, Evasive or Dynamic modes. Dynamic squads adjust to morale and perceived threat: push, hold, fall back or re-engage.

name: Fireteam Target Assignment
desc: The squad splits targets between main and auxiliary fireteams so the whole group doesn't fixate on one enemy.

name: Squad Suppression
desc: Squad-level suppressive fire on a threat area. Fire rate scales with distance, since suppression needs volume more than precision.

name: Squad Investigation
desc: The squad investigates contacts together instead of individual soldiers wandering off alone.

name: Waypoint Discipline
desc: AI respects mission-maker waypoints more reliably while still reacting to contact.

name: Radio Info sharing
desc: Contacts propagate between groups and up to the commander, with radio callouts built from a phrase bank.

name: Tactics
desc: If no custom settings are forced, the Group leader will initiate Five types of tactics.

name: Bounding overwatch
desc: Squads will separate into two fireteams advancing using bounding overwatch.

name: Basic vehicle behaviour
desc: Vehicles detect enemies, move to positions with line of sight, engage with suppressive or direct fire and take cover behind terrain when threatened.

name: Support-by-Fire Positioning
desc: Dedicated vehicle positioning logic with anti-tank threat awareness, stand-off distance and gunner behaviour.

name: Automatic Vehicle Usage
desc: When enabled, groups board and use nearby vehicles and crew available turrets on their own. Vehicles already owned by another group are left alone.

name: Dedicated Transport
desc: Transport teams pick up infantry, drive them to the LZ and disembark them, then either return to base or wait at the LZ for the next job. Boarding, driving and disembark all have timeouts so nothing gets stuck.

name: AI Commander
desc: An autonomous commander that thinks in cycles: reads the battlefield, assigns groups to objectives and adapts. Runs in Offensive, Defensive or Balanced mode.

name: Objective System
desc: Capture, Destroy and Recon objectives with priorities from Negligible to Critical. Objectives track presence and contested state, and the commander sets up defences on what it holds.

name: Group Roles
desc: The commander gives each group a role: Recon, Assault, Flank, Transport, Reserve, Retreat, Reinforce, Defend, Armored, Artillery or Suppress.

name: Threat Response & QRF
desc: Contact reports are clustered into threats and scored. The commander dispatches QRF elements to the ones that matter and keeps reserves back.

name: Contact Reports
desc: Groups report enemy contacts up to their commander, giving it a picture of the battlefield built from what its units actually saw.

name: Dynamic Frontline
desc: The frontline is built from the border between friendly and enemy territory. Groups spread along it and patrol with varied routes instead of piling onto one point.

name: Recon & Staging
desc: Recon goes where the enemy threat is highest and picks the best observation spot. Assault groups stage outside the target objective so they are ready before contact.

name: Artillery Request
desc: Fire missions on request: HE, smoke and illumination with selectable shell counts, approved by the commander, corrected between salvos and cancellable.

name: FOB Builder
desc: The commander establishes Forward bases, Firebases, Main bases and Mortar bases, sending a group to build each one and keeping them spaced apart.

name: Magazine Well Resupply
desc: Soldiers find ammo sources that match their weapon's magazine well and resupply on their own.

name: Arsenal Resupply
desc: AI locates the nearest arsenal that stocks the right magazine, moves to it and takes what it needs.

name: Emergency rearm
desc: Soldiers will pick up ammo for their rifle if available. If not, they will pick up nearby weapons that have available ammo for it.

name: GM Editor Attributes
desc: Set AI skill, accuracy, aim-improvement time and perception from the Game Master editor, globally or per unit.

name: Personality per Unit
desc: Assign Cautious, Standard, Aggressive or Reckless personality to individual units from the editor.

name: Suppression Coefficient
desc: Scale how hard suppression affects AI, globally or per unit.

name: Hold Position Action
desc: Context action to pin a group in place.

name: Dodge & Cover Settings
desc: Dodge chance, cooldown, distance, shot threshold and take-cover chance exposed as editor sliders, globally or per unit.

name: Grenade / GL Usage Sliders
desc: Control how often AI uses hand grenades and grenade launchers, from never to twice the default.

name: Magic Ammo
desc: Toggle unlimited ammo for AI globally or per unit, for long scenarios without logistics.

name: Vehicle Dismount Control
desc: Decide globally or per squad whether infantry dismounts from vehicles in combat.

name: Server JSON Config
desc: Server-side settings in $profile:DCO/DCO_GlobalConfig.json. The file is generated from the current values on first run; when new keys appear the old file is backed up to .bak and only the missing keys are added, so admin values survive updates. Radio lines and UI defaults have their own files.

name: Commander Assignment
desc: Assign groups and vehicles to a specific AI commander from the editor, or release them back.

name: Commander Debug Overlay
desc: GM-only 3D overlay that shows what the commander believes: contact reports, threat clusters, frontline and the thresholds behind each decision.

name: DCO Conflict Game mode
desc: DCO version of the Reforger Conflict mode but with our own High command, spawn and capture systems. Commander will assess threats, coordinate defence and attacks on objectives as well as send reinforcements and support to requesting groups.

name: Capture & Hold
desc: Capture-and-hold mode: win by reaching the score limit or holding the required number of bases.

name: PvE Commander Spawner
desc: Infantry and vehicle respawners for PvE, with a balancer that scales AI count to the number of players (base + players x multiplier, clamped).

name: Building Occupying
desc: Garrison system: AI fills buildings by slot (windows, roof, balcony, doors) in Hold, Defend or Release mode, spreads across several buildings, refills slots when defenders die and breaks the leash when the enemy gets close or casualties mount.

name: Group Threat Assessor
desc: Squad prioritizes and assigns targets intelligently.

name: Group Cohesion
desc: Squad spacing keeps members apart without losing the group, and straggler watch pulls back anyone who falls behind.

name: Group Morale
desc: Squad morale affects collective aggression and routing.

name: Mechanized Squad Combat
desc: IFV/APC squad coordinates dismount and assault.

name: Vehicle Suppression
desc: Vehicles pin down infantry using suppressive fire.

name: Vehicle Tactics
desc: Flanking, bounding overwatch, fire-and-maneuver.

name: Resupply Point
desc: Vehicles navigate to and use resupply depots autonomously.

name: Player Command Interface
desc: Players command AI through the group radial menu: report contacts (team, squad, platoon, vehicle, armor), request suppression, support, flanks or armor, call transport, extraction and MEDEVAC, hand out roles, and cancel any standing order.

name: Trench Warfare
desc: Improved pathfinding and movement so AI uses trenches and fighting positions properly. Announced as a focus for an upcoming update.

name: Commander Tactics
desc: Thirteen named tactics the commander picks from the situation: movement to contact, recon in force, fire and maneuver, flanking, hammer and anvil, pincer, infiltration, siege, bypass, raid, attack by fire, pursuit and delay.

name: Commander Defense
desc: Defensive play: ambushes along supply routes, observation posts, counter-attacks, counter-battery fire and feints — each one tunable from the Game Master editor.

name: Objective Memory & Prep Fire
desc: The commander remembers what it learned about each objective: intel, previous attack attempts and losses. It prepares fire before assaulting, consolidates after taking ground and calls in armor support.

name: Radio Comms & Callouts
desc: A phrase bank builds radio traffic with callsign, grid, direction, distance and ETA. Lines vary by faction, by the speaker's personality and by whether the situation is calm or critical.

name: Commander Spawner
desc: The commander can spawn and feed its own units, set up from the Game Master editor.

name: Terrain Cache
desc: Terrain is sampled and cached so the commander can judge cover, roads and open ground without re-scanning the map every decision.

name: Player HUD & Map Overlay
desc: Order banners, contact toasts and a map overlay show what the commander is doing and what your squad has been told. Position, scale and sound are set per player.

name: Logistics Dispatch
desc: Commander-run logistics jobs: transport, extraction, MEDEVAC and resupply, coordinated from a logistics hub that also tracks casualties.

name: Medic Dispatch
desc: Medics are dispatched to casualties across groups, weighing distance, whether the casualty is unconscious and whether the area is under fire.

name: Close-Quarters Combat
desc: Dedicated close-range behaviour for room and corner fighting, separate from open-field combat.

name: Long-Range Engagement
desc: Distinct behaviour at long range: engagement distances, patience and positioning instead of charging every contact.

name: Night Behaviour
desc: Night changes how AI moves, spots and engages, beyond the existing detection penalty.

name: Squad Spacing
desc: Members hold sensible spacing so a single grenade or burst does not take out the whole squad.

name: Straggler Watch
desc: Anyone who falls behind or gets stuck is noticed and brought back to the group.

name: Group Strength Tracking
desc: The group tracks its own combat strength, which feeds morale, tactics and the commander's decisions.

name: AI Commander Placement
desc: Place an AI Commander straight from the Game Master content browser, then assign groups and vehicles to it.

name: Garrison Waypoint
desc: A Garrison (DCO) waypoint in the commanding menu, with hold/defend/release mode, building count, slot fill, firing arc weight, roof slots, refill delays and release triggers.

name: Expanded GM Attributes
desc: Seventeen DCO attribute categories in the editor, covering global skill, combat, reaction, idle, contact sharing, medic, players, squad, squad commander, objectives, commander threat and artillery, plus per-unit settings and group tooltips.

name: Performance & LOD Budgets
desc: Global level-of-detail and update budgets so large AI counts stay affordable on a server.

name: Benchmark Logger
desc: Writes FPS, live AI per faction, commander and objective state, plus per-group and per-vehicle dumps to log files for performance testing.
